hints.title: Row and Column Sum Precalculation
hints.text: A position (r, c) is special if mat[r][c] == 1, row r has exactly one 1, and column c has exactly one 1.

hints.title: Frequency Vectors
hints.text: Precompute row_sum of size R and col_sum of size C by summing elements along each row and column.

hints.title: Count Special Coordinates
hints.text: Scan the matrix. Increment answer whenever mat[r][c] == 1, row_sum[r] == 1, and col_sum[c] == 1.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rechecking full rows and columns for every 1 takes O(R * C * (R + C)) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Row and column sum arrays take O(R + C) space, allowing O(1) checks per cell in a single pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate precomputes row/column sums to reduce validation to constant time per entry.
